title: DOCY authoritative graph and house rules
summary: Documents are views of shared typed and layered content, and outputs are projections, not source.
semantics: Nodes have stable semantic identities independent of placements, which may occur in many documents.
Property precedence is variant, document, project, template and house; overrides remain explicit.
Command nodes reject an accidental trailing period, Credits are mandatory, and STOP/WARN/INFO are accumulated.
Node classes are registered and own their rendering and validation; the store must not enumerate types.
Markdown, HTML, PDF and ODT cannot silently replace the DOCY authoritative graph.
